What to look for: this is a class template `Test<int ID>` with a NON-const
`static int Num` member, defined out-of-class as `template<int ID> int
Test<ID>::Num = 2;`. On DXC (dxc_1_6_2112, dxc_trunk) this is expected to
compile like an ordinary global, matching the working non-templated and
templated-const-static-member cases described in the linked issue.

dxc_1_6_2112 predates HLSL template support entirely ("'template' is a
reserved keyword in HLSL") -- it cannot exercise this code path at all and is
not evidence either way.

dxc_trunk instead fails with "LLVM ERROR: Broken module found, compilation
aborted!". That is DXC's LLVM IR-verifier fatal-error path. Locally, on
downloaded v1.7.2308 and v1.9.2607 release binaries, the same input produces
the specific verifier diagnostic quoted in the issue itself, "Declaration may
not be in a Comdat!", immediately before that abort -- see out-v1.7.2308.txt
and out-v1.9.2607.txt in this issue's directory (not reproduced in this CE
pane, which does not surface that particular verifier line, only the final
abort message).
